## Details

<a id="arena2_bitmap"></a>
### [`arena2_bitmap`](../../../../src/graphics/arena2_bitmap.asm#L6) `$D000-$D010`

*data*

Bitmap of the arena that is not on screen: character rows 7-22, columns 4-35, 256 bytes for each row. $8f49 swaps it with $a678-$b677 when the arena changes. The code sets $01 to $20 to read it.

- **Written by:** [`copy_sprite_shadows`](../sprites/sprite_shadow.md#copy_sprite_shadows)
- **Referred to by:** [`swap_centre_store`](../screen/scene.md#swap_centre_store)
